sloka: गिरि प्रस्थेषु रम्येषु पुष्पवद्भिः मनोरमैः ।संसक्त शिखरा शैला विराजन्ति महाद्रुमैः ॥४-१-१९॥
transliteration: giri prastheṣu ramyeṣu puṣpavadbhiḥ manoramaiḥ ।saṁsakta śikharā śailā virājanti mahādrumaiḥ ॥4-1-19॥

translations.english: 'The huge trees in the scenic mountainranges look delightful with their blossoms touching the peaks.
